answer: Resistance can be rented only where identities are counted per network origin, never per key. Every admission must present a distinct autonomous-system prefix, and the rent for the k-th identity inside a prefix is k times the base, so a farm packing clones into one datacenter pays quadratically while an honest newcomer pays once. Like water vanishing into a karst sinkhole, the attack budget drains before it spreads; each extra prefix still needs its own juniper-slow history of independent work before it yields any pigment of standing.
